channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Torrey Craig | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Torrey Craig from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Monty Williams on Torrey Craig
item.description:
After Torrey Craig had to be helped back to the locker room with an apparent leg injury, Suns coach Monty Williams told me:

“Torrey is a tough dude. If he lays down like that, he’s hurting pretty bad.”

Monty Williams on Torrey Craig, Jul 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @malika_andrews.

item.title: Deandre Ayton on E'Twaun Moore, Jae Crowder, Langston Galloway, Torrey Craig
item.description:
“In the bubble, with the way we handled ourselves, team success comes with individual accolades. I think that is what really happened in the bubble. I saw each and every one of us really grow. We won some games and we started to put the right staff in. That is why we are here, to be honest. Whatever we are doing [now], was built in the bubble. “Winning was contagious and we added pieces like CP, Jae [Crowder], E’Twaun Moore, Langston Galloway and Torrey Craig. Those are guys who have been in the game and played at high levels like this. That is the best way I can think of how I turned my career into a positive one.”

Deandre Ayton on E'Twaun Moore, Jae Crowder, Langston Galloway, Torrey Craig, Jun 23, 2021. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Torrey Craig
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Mike Budenholzer on Torrey Craig:

“Torrey's a good player. I think the reason he's helping Phoenix is he brings some things to the table.”

Mike Budenholzer on Torrey Craig, Apr 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Michael Malone on Torrey Craig
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Malone on Torrey Craig:

“Torrey in the time he was here had a tremendous impact on our culture, on our winning... I miss Torrey Craig the person. I have a lot of respect for who he is.”

Michael Malone on Torrey Craig, Feb 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Mason Plumlee, Jerami Grant, Torrey Craig
item.description:
Katy Winge:Coach Malone on possibly becoming a more offensive-minded team with the loss of Plumlee, Grant, & Craig:

“I’m all about offense now baby! We’re going to score 130 a night.”

Michael Malone on Mason Plumlee, Jerami Grant, Torrey Craig, Dec 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @katywinge.

item.title: Jon Horst on Torrey Craig
item.description:
The MilwaukeeBucks have signed forward Torrey Craig, guard Bryn Forbes and forward Bobby Portis.

“We’ve bolstered the depth of our roster with the additions of Torrey, Bryn and Bobby,”

Jon Horst on Torrey Craig, Nov 26, 2020. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Monte Morris on Mason Plumlee, Torrey Craig
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Monte Morris on Mason Plumlee and Torrey Craig attending Team USA Training Camp:

“I think it’s phenomenal….Them bringing that knowledge from USA Training Camp, if they can bring that to our training camp and teach me some more things about the game, that I’m looking forward to.”

Monte Morris on Mason Plumlee, Torrey Craig, Aug 4, 2019. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Torrey Craig
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Pop on Torrey Craig:

“There’s always someobody that steps up in the playoffs, and he’s stepped up. That’s just the way it is...”

Gregg Popovich on Torrey Craig, Apr 23, 2019. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Torrey Craig
item.description:
#Nuggets POBO,Tim Connelly, on his team's All-Star representation:

“So excited for Nikola, but he shouldn't be our only player in Charlotte. Jamal's personal & team success made him worthy. And the impact Monte and Torrey have made merited a spot in the Rising Stars Challenge.”

Tim Connelly on Torrey Craig, Feb 2, 2019. Source: Twitter @chrisadempsey.
